policies.money: PostgreSQL numeric; major currency units; never JS arithmetic
policies.tax_shipping_discount: no additional allocation or adjustment; source unit-price inclusion policy unverified
policies.revenue: not paid/net revenue and not allocated order total
policies.refund_cancellation: no deduction without separate lifecycle contract
policies.catalog: current names only; never current prices
policies.quality: block if any source order or items invalid; no silent exclusion
policies.deduplication: one order once; conflicting ordered item arrays block
